evals.prompt: We're shipping 2.4.0 tomorrow. Here's `git log --oneline v2.3.0..HEAD` saved in evals/files/v2.4.0.log — can you turn it into release notes for our users? They're not devs, keep it readable.
evals.expected_output: RELEASE_NOTES.md with Breaking (v1 /export removed, what to do: switch to /v2/export) first, then New (dark mode), Improved (faster search), Fixed (CSV truncation, session expiry); chores/ci/refactor/test/contributor docs dropped; every kept PR number preserved.
expectations: The first section is breaking changes and contains #412
The #412 entry tells users what to do (use /v2/export)
Entries for #405, #407, #409 and #404 are present with their PR numbers
None of #403, #406, #408, #410, #411 appear in the notes
No bullet contains Conventional Commit prefixes or scopes such as 'feat(', 'fix(', 'perf('
Commit hashes do not appear in the notes

evals.prompt: need a user-facing changelog for 3.0 from these commits (evals/files/v3.0.0.log). it's a major so make sure people know what breaks
evals.expected_output: Two breaking entries (Node 16 dropped; outDir renamed to outputDir) each with an action; the reverted interactive prompt (#522/#529) omitted; security fix (#527) kept in plain language; ci/build/merge/README lines dropped; no invented migration details.
expectations: Breaking changes come first and include both #530 and #525
The #525 entry tells users to rename outDir to outputDir in their config
The #530 entry tells users to upgrade Node (to 18 or later, or flags the exact version as a TODO) rather than inventing unsupported detail
Neither #522 nor #529 appears (the feature was reverted)
#527 is kept and described as a security fix
None of #524, #526, the merge commit or the README badge commit appear

evals.prompt: Write the release notes for users for 1.8.1, log is in evals/files/v1.8.1.log
evals.expected_output: States there are no user-facing changes in this release; does not invent features or list internal commits.
expectations: The output states there are no user-facing changes
None of #296-#301 appear as release-note bullets
No New/Fixed/Improved sections with invented content
